home.headline: Smarter Farming. Healthier Crops. Stronger Communities.
home.subtext: ResilienceNet uses AI-powered crop analysis, weather information, and farming recommendations to help farmers make better decisions and reduce crop losses.
home.problem1Text: Diseases can spread quickly and are often hard to identify early without expert help.
home.problem2Text: Sudden weather changes make planning and protecting crops more difficult.
home.problem3Text: Many farmers don't have quick access to agricultural specialists when issues arise.
home.problem4Text: Delayed diagnosis and treatment often leads to preventable crop damage.
home.problem5Text: Repeated crop losses threaten the stability of local and regional food supplies.
home.feature1Text: Identify crop diseases quickly from an uploaded image.
home.feature2Text: Get guidance on how to treat and manage identified issues.
home.feature3Text: Stay informed with weather conditions relevant to your farm.
home.feature4Text: Receive practical suggestions to improve crop health over time.
